summary: Navigation and session-history handling became safer and more predictable: Firefox now rate-limits every navigation, validates content-provided history data and process-specific origins, handles redirects and javascript: URLs consistently, and avoids invalid BFCache or history operations. Service-worker behavior gained a site policy for disabling workers, while privacy-related partitioning preferences and obsolete telemetry were removed. The area also improves scrollbar boundaries around rounded chrome corners and refreshes the about:sync-log experience.
